headline: Session done — long mountain run delivered as prescribed, strong execution
summary: Solid execution: 2h37 moving / 937m D+ against the 2h45 / ~1050m target, avg HR 145bpm sitting right in the prescribed 145-155 Z2 band for the bulk of the run, with a clear harder finishing block (last lap 7:40 at 163bpm matching the race-effort climb+descent intent). RPE 7, feel "great" (1) — this is the session the week was built around, and it landed almost exactly on plan. CTL jumped 50.8 → 52.8 (today's load 139, close to the 175 estimate once you account for intervals.icu's tendency to undercount steep climb/descent work) — the Berici vertical is translating into fitness gains right where you need it five weeks from VWT.
flags: No knee/ITB complaints flagged in RPE/feel data — good, keep watching on tomorrow's descents if any soreness shows up overnight.

This week's ramp rate is now +2.6/wk off a high ATL (67.6) — fine against the <6 CTL guardrail, but Sunday's 120-load run (1h50/~450m) is the next load checkpoint; confirm HRV/RHR before adding anything on top.
suggestedChange: If Saturday's Strava benchmark segment (Californication UP) time/HR data comes through, worth pulling that split specifically to compare against the July 7:39@168bpm reference — it's the cleanest read on aerobic gain since then.
